role: non-writing independent paired-manuscript scientific, APS and contextual-prose reviewer
direct_reading_scope: Entire paired Korean and English manuscripts including authorship paragraphs and two references
All title/summary/tag/date fields in editorial metadata
Previously recorded direct QSSDv1 algorithm, hardware benchmark, Table2, runtime Table5 and AppendixG source checks; original DQB2-page text, no new source experiments

Existing September4 review registration original/revision dates and Korean final comparison paragraphs inspected directly; English matching conclusion checked on follow-up. This was a relevant-section continuity check, not a new full-paper audit.
passed_findings: A classical 0/1 answer is compatible with the paper's +/-1 spin encoding; frozen-variable interactions enter conditional reduced coefficients, not a coherent encoding of all10000variables.
The approximately0.95 score is energy-bound-normalized solution quality, not fraction of correctly assigned variables.
The10000-variable n152,p8,T100 benchmark, SA0.992, and HiGHS3310-second optimum are correctly distinguished from G35 and from matched-runtime evidence.
QAOA angle setting from reduced coefficients and low-energy candidate populations are correctly described without variational training claims.
Sampler contribution and a strong classical comparator directly develop the existing September4 question. The final paragraph is relevant scientific comparison, not a generic cost refrain.
The manufacturing-scheduling comparison is explicitly editorial future evaluation, not performed application or reproduced experiment.
Primary APS title and three-author order match arXivv1; existing review is separately cited in the last paragraph.
The manuscripts do not force the other DQB research items into a common scientific result or create a new deep-review proposal.
Korean and English preserve scientific conditions, original issue/editorial/evidence dates and distinction between current editorial-model provenance and external original authorship.

style_assessment.translation_note: English is natural overall; prefer explicit complete-trial and algorithm-rule scope over literal execution/fixed phrasing.

limits: No manuscript/source edits performed by this reviewer.
No local render, build, whole-artifact validation, scientific reproduction or human-reader study performed.
Final approval covers the three current bound source inputs. Compilation, PDF final page rendering and deployed output remain separate review scopes.

resolved_changes.issue: One QPU run can be mistaken for one circuit execution, although the single complete QSSD trial contains100circuit iterations.
resolved_changes.recommended_ko: 100회 반복으로 이뤄진 QSSD 전체를 한 번 시험한 결과이며, 각 반복의 회로에 1만 샷을 사용했다.
resolved_changes.recommended_en: This was one complete hardware-based QSSD trial, with10,000shots for the circuit in each iteration.

resolved_changes.issue: Holding variable selection fixed can be read as freezing the actual selected-variable sequence; changing the sampler also changes the population and therefore later selections. The rules should be held unchanged.
resolved_changes.recommended_ko: 변수 선택과 비트 후처리의 규칙을 유지한 채 표본 생성기만 바꾸는 비교
resolved_changes.recommended_en: keep the variable-selection and bit-flip post-processing rules unchanged, and change the sampler

addressed_optional_clarifications.suggestion: Specify that classical bit-flip post-processing can examine all m variables, not only the currently quantum-selected subset; AppendixG explicitly identifies this scope.
Including10,000would make the large-answer/152-at-a-time relationship correspond more closely to the Korean title; current title is not scientifically false.
After the review is complete, use past-tense checked wording when finalizing; the present cross-check statement is accurate only as an in-progress description.

followup_scope: Retain original full-body science/prose review. Latest narrow followup independently signs off only the shortened bilingual summaries and rebinds their metadata; title, date, tags, source credit and all other metadata are equal, with body/fragment/PDF/model preservation checks.

binding_followups.scope: First occurrence QSSD/QAOA name expansions only; exact inverse replacement restores previously reviewed manuscript bytes. No science or metadata change.
Summary-only metadata revision; nonwriter editorial signoff, not user publication approval. Original complete paired-manuscript/source review and all prior followups remain in force.

before_summaries.summary: 현재 답안에서 일부 변수만 골라 바꾸면 작은 양자 회로로 큰 문제를 탐색할 수 있다. 고정한 변수의 상호작용을 반영하는 QSSD의 원리와 실제 비교 결과에서, 표본 생성기가 전체 탐색에 보태는 역할을 살핀다.
before_summaries.summary_en: QSSD revises selected variables in a classically stored answer while retaining their interactions with the rest. Its mechanism and hardware comparisons clarify how a sampler contributes to a larger search.

after_summaries.summary: QSSD가 작은 회로로 큰 문제를 탐색하는 원리를 설명하고, 고전 방법과 비교해 양자 표본의 역할을 살핀다.
after_summaries.summary_en: QSSD searches large problems through partial updates. Classical baselines help assess its quantum sampler.

editorial_judgment.scientific_meaning: Passed. The Korean summary describes small-circuit exploration and classical comparisons to assess quantum samples. The English summary describes partial updates and classical baselines to assess the quantum sampler. Neither adds a quantum-advantage or equal-budget claim.
editorial_judgment.bilingual_alignment: Passed at short-summary scope; both convey subset-based large-problem optimization and classical comparison of the sampler role.
editorial_judgment.reader_friendly_prose: Passed. Direct and concise; no stock reveal, forced contrast, generic conclusion or translation-like metaphor.
editorial_judgment.limitations: The shorter summaries omit frozen-variable interactions and the classically stored candidate; these remain explicit in the unchanged reviewed body.
